data.title: Helius Launches Beta Historical Accounts API for Querying Account States at Any Point
data.description: Solana RPC provider Helius has launched the beta version of its Historical Accounts API. According to Odaily, the API can retrieve the complete state of any account, liquidity pool or wallet at the end of a specified slot or after a transaction executes. It can be used to backtest trading strategies, check historical token supply, calculate PnL, retrieve past wallet balances and track changes in DEX liquidity over time.

data.title: Bitcoin News | Bitcoin Falls to $68,000 as Analysts Split on Whether Anthropic’s 6x-Oversubscribed IPO Is Draining Crypto
data.description: Bitcoin fell to around $68,000 overnight, its lowest since August, extending a slide of more than 20% since early October as a series of market shocks weighed on crypto. It was last trading near $67,240.Analysts disagree on what’s driving the latest drop. Some point to investors raising cash for Anthropic’s IPO, while others see a broader move out of riskier assets.Anthropic IPO Draws Six Times More Orders Than SharesAnthropic’s IPO, which could raise up to $64.4 billion, is about six times oversubscribed, Bloomberg reported. That means investors have placed orders for six times as many shares as are on offer.Seamus Rocca, CEO of Xapo Bank, said the opening of the order books is pulling money out of liquid markets as investors scramble for an allocation. “When an IPO of this scale comes to market, the lure of a quick return is strong, and liquid assets like bitcoin are often the first source of funding when investors scramble for allocations,” he said.Rocca called it set to be “the largest public listing in history, by a wide margin.” On its own, the IPO would raise less than SpaceX’s $75 billion listing in June. It would be larger only when combined with Anthropic’s separate $26 billion private placement, or if the deal is increased.Rocca compared the rush to SpaceX’s IPO, which he said temporarily drained money from bitcoin. He added that bitcoin has held up relatively well given the amount of bad news markets have absorbed.Other Analysts See Broad Risk-CuttingOther analysts see the drop as part of a market-wide retreat from risk rather than anything specific to bitcoin.“Gold’s decline shows me it is a wholesale derisking deleveraging of the AI trade,” said Mark Connors, chief investment strategist at Risk Dimensions.Chris Sullivan, co-portfolio manager at Hyperium Decimus, said he sees “no logical connection” between Nvidia’s troubles and bitcoin. Instead, he pointed to:Short positions in bitcoin above their August peakLarge outflows from BlackRock’s IBITExtreme fear in crypto marketsThe chance of a 50 basis point Fed rate hike within the next 30 days“Metals are trading lower with crypto, which is again pretty insane,” Sullivan said.Nvidia CEO Exit and Strategy’s MSCI Removal Add PressureSeveral other events have weighed on sentiment:Nvidia: CEO Jensen Huang resigned on November 12, with CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO. Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% that day, hitting the wider AI trade.Strategy: MSCI is removing Strategy, the largest corporate holder of bitcoin, from its USA Index at the close of November 30 under new rules for non-operating companies. That could force index-tracking funds to sell its shares.Jim Ferraioli, head of crypto research at the Schwab Center for Financial Research, said the timing of bitcoin’s sharpest drop, around 11 p.m. Eastern, suggests neither event was the direct trigger.SpaceX IPO Pattern Points to $90,000, One Analyst SaysStrive CEO Matt Cole sees parallels with SpaceX’s IPO. Bitcoin fell 19% in the 50 days before SpaceX listed, compared with 18% over the same period ahead of Anthropic’s planned debut.After SpaceX went public, bitcoin kept falling and hit a low 18 days later, then recovered. By day 100 it was 28% above its level on the listing day. “If Anthropic follows the same pattern, most of the drawdown is behind us, and it could reverse quickly over the next couple of months,” Cole said. A repeat would put bitcoin near $90,000 by late February, he said.The comparison has limits. Bitcoin’s drop around the SpaceX IPO also came with concerns about bitcoin sales by Strategy, so the IPO wasn’t the only factor.

data.title: XRP ETF Outflows Hit an 8-Month High as December Rarely Reverses Losses
data.description:
US spot XRP ETFs lost $19.13 million in the week ending November 13, their largest weekly outflow in 8 months, as XRP fell below $1.00. The funds recorded a second straight week of outflows, while XRP fell 20% in November, according to BeInCrypto.

The funds lost $10.42 million on November 9 and $7.62 million on November 10, followed by a $1.09 million outflow on Friday. Only three weeks since the ETFs launched in November 2025 had larger withdrawals: the weeks ending January 23, January 30, and March 13. Broader crypto ETF outflows totaled $1.48 billion from November 4 to 10. XRP ETF net assets fell 14% in a week to $1.15 billion; withdrawals accounted for about $19 million of a $191 million decline, with falling prices causing most of the drop.

XRP stood at $0.9947, down 14.88% over the past week and about 73% below its $3.65 all-time high from July 17, 2025. BeInCrypto’s analysis identifies $0.99 as support; a break could expose $0.97, then $0.93 to $0.96, with extended selling potentially taking XRP to $0.80. A rebound would first need to clear $1.09 to $1.11.

XRP ended November lower in 7 of the 13 years from 2013 to 2025, and December fell in 6 of those years, according to CryptoRank. The exception was 2015, when December gained 43.8%. In 2025, XRP fell 13.8% in November and 14.8% in December. Investors have put a net $1.79 billion into the ETFs since launch, but their holdings are now worth $1.15 billion.

data.title: Eric Trump-Backed Foundation Misses Payroll After Founder Borrowed $4.6 Million for Home
data.description: According to CNBC, Foundation Future Industries, the military humanoid-robot startup backed by Eric Trump, missed payroll on Oct. 30, and employees had yet to receive their paychecks as cash reserves dwindled. People familiar with the matter said CEO and co-founder Sankaet Pathak borrowed $4.6 million from the company last year to buy a luxury home. Public records show an LLC naming Pathak as its sole principal purchased a $4.6 million property in Sausalito, California, in October 2025.

data.title: WORPT Lets Tourists Convert Cryptocurrency to Thai Baht for Spending Without a Thai Bank Account
data.description: Thailand has launched WORPT, a payment app that lets foreign tourists convert cryptocurrency into Thai baht and pay by scanning barcodes used by local shops and restaurants, without opening a Thai bank account. According to Odaily, the app was developed by Wipay and Waan Exchange, which was founded by Chaval Jiaravanon. WORPT operates under the TouristDigiPay regulatory pilot launched by Thailand’s Securities and Exchange Commission.

data.title: FortiGuard Labs Reports Hackers Hijacked Microsoft SQL Servers to Deploy Gh0st RAT and Monero Miners
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Crypto Briefing, FortiGuard Labs disclosed an attack campaign targeting Microsoft SQL Server databases exposed to the internet. Attackers used weak passwords and misconfigurations to break into servers through brute-force attacks, then enabled xp_cmdshell to install two malicious payloads: a Monero miner disguised as MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.exe and a Gh0st RAT variant capable of keylogging and taking screenshots.

Both payloads established persistence by modifying the registry and creating scheduled tasks. FortiGuard Labs said the campaign has been active since at least early October 2026. The number of victims has not been confirmed, and the attack has not been attributed to a specific actor.

data.title: Indonesia's Prabowo Orders State to Take at Least 70% of Mining Permit Proceeds
data.description: President Prabowo Subianto said Saturday that the state should receive a larger share of proceeds from mining permits and, if necessary, hold controlling stakes in mining assets. According to Sina Finance, he told members of Muhammadiyah that at least 70% of the proceeds from mining permits should go to the state; the presidential palace later clarified that the figure referred to proceeds generated by mining permit operations. Prabowo added that Indonesia welcomes investment in mining, but that profits should primarily go to the Indonesian people.

data.title: Strive Says It Could Survive Bitcoin Falling to 1 Cent With No Debt Forcing Sales
data.description: Strive Inc. CEO Matt Cole said the company could survive even if Bitcoin fell to 1 cent because it has no debt that could force it to sell its Bitcoin. According to Odaily, Cole made the remarks Thursday on the Pomp Podcast, saying Strive finances itself only through preferred stock and has no price level that would trigger a forced Bitcoin liquidation; borrowing to take a long position, by contrast, can lead to liquidation after a steep price decline. Strive’s SATA preferred stock pays a floating dividend currently at about 13%, which will rise to 13.25% in December, while its SATS preferred stock pays a fixed 15% dividend.

data.title: Binance Zero-Knowledge Proof Enables Verification of Minimum 1:1 Asset Backing
data.description: Binance announced on X that its zero-knowledge proof has been generated, allowing users to independently verify that their assets on Binance are backed at a minimum of 1:1.

data.title: More Than 99% of INJ Stakers Back Injective Veyra Mainnet Upgrade, Vote Expected to Pass in Two Days
data.description: More than 99% of INJ stakers have voted in favor of the Injective Veyra mainnet upgrade. According to Odaily, Injective said on X that the proposal is expected to pass in two days if the current trend continues.

data.title: Avalanche Foundation Awards Up to $50,000 Each to Six Blockchain Economics Research Projects
data.description: The Avalanche Foundation has awarded grants of up to $50,000 each to six research projects, according to Crowdfund Insider. According to Foresight News, recipients include Stanford University, the University of Oxford, Imperial College London, Nanyang Technological University, the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), and the University of Saskatchewan. The projects examine topics including value accrual in Layer 1 ecosystems, the effect of staking on token valuation, and the macroeconomics of decentralization in proof-of-stake networks. Their findings will help guide the development of the Avalanche network.

data.title: AI Agents Process 6.4 Million x402 Payments, but News Is Missing From Top Purchases
data.description:
AI agents made 6.4 million x402 payments on Solana and Base from July 23 to August 26, 2026, but news products were absent from the most-called paid resources. The figures come from BeInCrypto Research’s State of AI Agent Payments 2026 report, according to BeInCrypto. The payments totaled $119,947; 90.8% were below one cent and accounted for 10.7% of the value. Solana recorded 94.5% of transactions in eight days, from August 19 to 26.

The report’s x402 catalogue listed 14,791 paid resources across 1,610 hostnames from August 16 to September 15, 2026. Its most-called resource was a two-cent AI-generated token safety check; web searches, Twitter searches and webpage reads also ranked in the top 10, but no news product did. Yana Prikhodchenko said agents could buy individual articles with stablecoins through x402, without subscriptions. Meanwhile, Google Search referrals to more than 2,500 news sites fell 33% between November 2024 and November 2025. ChatGPT referrals are growing, but Google still sends about 500 times as many readers. Only a fifth of digital leaders surveyed by the Reuters Institute expect AI licensing deals to generate substantial revenue.

data.title: Zelensky Says U.S. Proposed NATO Membership in Exchange for Ukraine Giving Up Donbas
data.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said a U.S. envoy asked whether Ukraine would cede the eastern Donbas region to Russia in exchange for a chance to join NATO. According to Sina Finance, Zelensky said the U.S. proposal included concrete security guarantees from NATO and the European Union, a strong Ukrainian military with sufficient personnel, weapons and financial support for a specified period, and a reconstruction plan with secured funding. He said he would ask Ukrainians whether they accepted the proposal if the United States and other NATO partners confirmed those terms, adding that he could not make the decision alone.

data.title: AI | Odd Lots: Bernstein’s Stacy Rasgon Is Pessimistic on Nvidia’s Post-Huang Outlook
data.description: Bernstein managing director and senior analyst Stacy Rasgon is not optimistic about Nvidia’s short-term future as the company enters the post-Jensen Huang era, according to Bloomberg. The Odd Lots podcast discusses questions about who Nvidia’s board will choose as its next CEO, whether the government will crack down on the chipmaker’s business practices, particularly in Asia, and whether uncertainty around Nvidia could spill over to AI labs and data center providers.

data.title: Binance Convert and Buy/Sell Add Fiat Purchases for bStocks
data.description: Binance announced on X that Binance Convert and Buy/Sell now support fiat purchases of bStocks, offering tokenized stock exposure through up to 49 local currencies. Purchases can be made using a fiat balance, card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

data.title: PYBOBO to Unlock $3.09 Million in Tokens on November 21
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing RootData, Capybobo (PYBOBO) is scheduled to unlock approximately 7.69 billion tokens, valued at about $3.09 million, at 12:00 AM (UTC+8) on November 21.

data.title: 1inch Tells Resolver Delegators to Claim Rewards and Undelegate by November 27
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, 1inch has urged staking users who delegated to resolvers to claim their rewards and complete undelegation by November 27. The newly added resolver delegation channel is closed. The change does not affect regular 1INCH staking, and users who stake independently do not need to undelegate or migrate.

data.title: Anonymous Address Adds $18.99 Million in BTC Shorts, With $35.69 Million in Total Losses
data.description: An unidentified address’s futures account has accumulated losses of about $35.69 million and increased its BTC short position by 282.42 BTC, valued at about $18.99 million. According to Odaily, the address currently holds a 282.42 BTC short position and opened BTC shorts worth about $16.81 million. The address is 0x1f250df59a777d61cb8bd043c12970f3afe4f925.

data.title: Honda Recalls 14,648 Vehicles in U.S. Over Brake Pressure and Crash Risks
data.description: According to Jin10, Honda is recalling 14,648 vehicles in the United States because a loss of brake pressure could reduce braking ability, increase stopping distances, and raise crash risk.

data.title: Cosmos Hub Proposal 1061 Surpasses Voting Threshold to Fix Governance Query Issue
data.description: According to ChainCatcher, Cosmos Hub Proposal 1061 to fix a governance query issue has entered the voting stage, surpassed the quorum threshold, and received near-unanimous support. If approved, validators will need to upgrade their nodes to Gaia v29.1.0 at block height 33,935,300.
